Subject: Q3 Launch: Owners handshake, playbook & QBR readout (action: sign-off)

Hi team —

I'm kicking off the owner-handshake and QBR-readout thread for our Q3 launch slate. Goal is simple: agree on the owner matrix, confirm the playbook responsibilities, and lock the QBR readout deck by end of next week.

Asks:
- Marcus: confirm SLA/KPI owners in the attached owner_matrix.csv and flag any gaps by EOD Tue.
- Irene: confirm dependency list (security/compliance and infra) and the readiness gating criteria.
- Vanessa: can you run a quick exec-brief dry run with Elaine (Acme) the week of May 10? Elaine — appreciate a short availability window.

Attached: owner_matrix.csv (draft), Q3_playbook_v1.pdf (outline).

If there's no material redline by Tue close-of-business, we'll treat the current doc as the baseline and onboard owners.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: owner_matrix.csv (spreadsheet), Q3_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 8 pages)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: Owners handshake, playbook & QBR readout (action: sign-off)

Thanks Tessa — quick pass below.

I reviewed owner_matrix.csv and made three edits:
1) SLA owner for inference latency -> moved from Platform to Serving Runtime (assign to Marcus Lin)
2) Cost/accounting owner -> Finance (we should loop in Naomi but can keep as TBD for now).
3) Added a note to the playbook about cache-warmup for predictable tail latency (see Q3_playbook_v1.pdf, page 4).

Open question: do we want a fallback model policy specified in the playbook or in the routing SLA doc? My vote is the playbook should call out the desired fallback behavior and link to routing policy for the mechanics.

I'll attach a marked-up owner_matrix.csv and a short diff for the playbook.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: owner_matrix_marked.csv (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: Owners handshake, playbook & QBR readout (action: sign-off)

Marcus/Tessa —

Thanks, Marcus — the SLA owner change makes sense. A couple of dependency notes from Security/Compliance:
- We need confirmation on data-retention policy for dedicated deployments (will affect the QBR slide on compliance posture).
- SOC2 evidence request window: legal needs the preliminary logs snapshot by May 14 to meet the audit timeline.

I've updated the dependency list in the playbook (see highlighted section) and added gating criteria:
- "Compliance-green" = SOC2 evidence uploaded + KMS integration validated in staging.
- "Infra-green" = autoscale policy exercised at 80% load and no eviction events in a 24-hour observation window.

On the fallback policy: security suggests we keep the decision matrix in the playbook but reference the routing policy for implementation details.

Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
